name: COV-FRAM — on-target gcov dump after a QUAL-FRAM run (development trial, not RfR)

event_patterns.framTester.WriteDone: FramTester write done client (?P<client>\d+) offset (?P<offset>\d+) length (?P<length>\d+): (?P<status>\w+)$
event_patterns.framTester.VerifyDone: FramTester verify done client (?P<client>\d+) offset (?P<offset>\d+) length (?P<length>\d+): (?P<status>\w+) mismatches (?P<mismatches>\d+)$
event_patterns.framTester.RawDone: FramTester raw (?P<op>\w+) done client (?P<client>\d+) offset (?P<offset>\d+) length (?P<length>\d+): (?P<status>\w+)$
event_patterns.framDriver.RequestRejected: F-RAM (?P<op>\w+) on port (?P<client>\d+) at offset (?P<offset>\d+) size (?P<length>\d+) rejected: (?P<status>\w+) \((?P<reason>\w+)\)$
event_patterns.framDriver.SpiError: F-RAM (?P<op>\w+) on port (?P<client>\d+) at offset (?P<offset>\d+) size (?P<length>\d+) failed with SPI status (?P<status>\w+) at (?P<stage>\w+)$
event_patterns.framTester.CoverageChunk: FramTester coverage chunk obj (?P<object>\d+) off (?P<offset>\d+) len (?P<length>\d+): (?P<data0>[0-9a-fA-F]+) (?P<data1>[0-9a-fA-F]+) (?P<data2>[0-9a-fA-F]+) (?P<data3>[0-9a-fA-F]+) (?P<data4>[0-9a-fA-F]+) (?P<data5>[0-9a-fA-F]+) (?P<data6>[0-9a-fA-F]+) (?P<data7>[0-9a-fA-F]+)$
event_patterns.framTester.CoverageDumpDone: FramTester coverage dump done: (?P<objects>\d+) objects, (?P<totalBytes>\d+) bytes, crc (?P<crc>[0-9a-fA-F]+)$

scope: Development trial only. One test: after the 14-test plan has run on the gcov-instrumented coverage-trial image (counters survive the plan's MCU resets and fth's flash+reset of the same image), stream the gcda data of FramDriver.cpp and FramTester.cpp to the ground as CoverageChunk events. Verifies nothing about the UUT; the record feeds `fth coverage-system`, which reassembles the .gcda files and runs gcovr.

tests.title: On-target gcov dump of FramDriver.cpp and FramTester.cpp
tests.purpose: Stream every gcda byte of the two instrumented objects to the ground, paced so the framer drops nothing. 160 x 2 chunks = 10 KiB window; the build's gcda total is ~6 KiB, so the walk ends inside it.
tests.setup: coverage-trial image flashed; the QUAL-FRAM plan run has just completed on it (counters preserved).
procedure: DUMP_COVERAGE(start, 2) for start = 0, 2, 4, ... 318 (160 commands; past the end only CoverageDumpDone repeats)
tests.evidence: Both objects announced once (their last chunk emitted exactly once); CoverageDumpDone follows; the reassembled gcda bytes' CRC-32 equals CoverageDumpDone.crc (checked by fth coverage-system).
